from pathlib import Path
import collections
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u060/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    lines = []\n    for r, row in enumerate(grid):\n        color, count = Counter(row).most_common(1)[0]\n        if color != background and count / w >= 0.8:\n            lines.append(([ (r, c) for c in range(w) ], color))\n    for c in range(w):\n        color, count = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0]\n        if color != background and count / h >= 0.8:\n            lines.append(([(r, c) for r in range(h)], color))\n    for cells, color in lines:\n        for r, c in cells:\n            out[r][c] = 2\n    return out\n'''
